notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.content:
Corrected two coordinates in level 26 of the Geometric campaign. The level is now solvable. Sorry for the inconvenience.

[i]Note:
If you are currently on this level make sure to restart it from the campaign window and not load it from the save game option.
[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused already unlocked campaign levels to get locked again if an earlier level was replayed and solved.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content: Level 46 of the Vanilla campaign was replaced with a less irritating level structure.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content: The default background music volume was increased by a notch since it was barely audible before, in comparison to the sound effects, even when on the highest setting.
